ownerMessages.meaning: Follow the PerfectDou/Suphx approach (perfect information during training, own hand at execution).
Run a live dashboard during training.
Interpreted as: use the Mac's full compute (7 actors + MPS learner at normal priority). macOS controls fan speed itself.

scope: One fixed 12-hour Mac training window plus its held-out evaluation. No change to the web champion, menu, frozen runs on other machines, reward definition, or Clint isolation.
assumedByAgent: The 12-hour window length was chosen by the agent; the owner can stop it at any time with the STOP file.
